The finite check does not prove the universal formula; the kernel classification does.

value.rationale: A complete centralizer distribution for a natural untruncated hereditary path-algebra family is a motivated invariant, stronger than merely counting distinct centralizers. The square-nonzero tensor product produces genuinely new strata and a same-vector-dimension comparison not available from the two-vertex radical-square-zero case, making an independently useful structural calculation rather than table repetition.

final_claim: For all finite fields F_q and r,s>=2, the ordinary three-vertex r/s-multiarrow path algebra admits a complete 14-stratum element-centralizer-dimension polynomial H_{r,s,q}(T). Its commuting probability is H(q)/q^(2(3+r+s+rs)), and A_{2,7} vs A_{3,5} over F2 have different probabilities despite equal dimension 26.
limitations: Only r,s>=2, no imposed zero relations, no classification of centralizer subalgebras up to isomorphism or arbitrary branching quivers.
